theme: The Rise and Fall (Grammatical Metaphor & Extreme Nominalisation)
phoneme_focus: Stress in long abstract noun phrases; dense-clause pacing

grammar_point.title: Grammatical metaphor & extreme nominalisation
grammar_point.en: Compress whole clauses into dense abstract noun phrases for high academic register (grammatical metaphor): 'because prices rose, sales fell' → 'the rise in prices led to a fall in sales'.
grammar_point.ar: ضغط جُمَل كاملة في عبارات اسمية مجرّدة كثيفة للأسلوب الأكاديمي العالي (الاستعارة النحوية).

vocabulary.example: Grammatical metaphor turns clauses into nouns.
The deterioration in conditions prompted action.
The emergence of new rivals reshaped the market.
The erosion of trust proved costly.
The proliferation of devices raised concerns.
It was the culmination of years of work.
The onset of winter slowed trade.
The advent of the railway transformed towns.
The imposition of tariffs hurt exporters.
The curtailment of spending was severe.
The alleviation of poverty is the goal.
Nominalisation increases abstraction.
Academic prose has lexical density.
Nominalisation allows compression.
The phrase is an encapsulation of the idea.
Her departure occasioned much comment.
The reform engendered resistance.
The news precipitated a decline.
It gave rise to fresh debate.
The policy brought about change.
The gain is attributable to demand.
The consequent rise in unemployment followed.
The ensuing confusion was total.
The effects were manifold.
It reflects a systemic failure.
The cumulative impact was large.
The underlying cause is structural.
The phenomenon is well documented.
The trajectory of decline is clear.
From its inception, the plan struggled.
The ramifications were far-reaching.

Saturday.prompt: Turn five 'because X, Y happened' statements into dense noun-phrase equivalents.

Monday.prompt: Give an academic summary using at least four nominalised abstractions.

Tuesday.prompt: Link cause and effect with 'occasioned', 'engendered', 'gave rise to'.

Wednesday.prompt: Trace a trajectory of change using abstract noun phrases.

Thursday.prompt: Discuss a complex issue with a partner in dense, formal academic register.

Friday.prompt: Present an academic analysis (10-12 sentences) rich in grammatical metaphor.

writing_prompts: Rewrite five clausal statements as dense abstract noun phrases.
Write three cause-effect sentences with 'occasioned', 'engendered', 'gave rise to'.
Write a highly nominalised academic-register paragraph.
Trace a trajectory of change using abstraction and compression.
Write a dense academic analysis paragraph using grammatical metaphor throughout.
